title_zh: 宁波舟山港：货物吞吐量世界第一
title_en: China's Ports (2/20): Ningbo-Zhoushan, the World's Busiest Cargo Port
note_en: The pattern 由…合并而成 describes something formed by merging parts: 是由宁波港和舟山港合并而成的 "was formed by merging Ningbo Port and Zhoushan Port." 由 introduces the ingredients, 合并 means "merge," and 而成 ("and thus become") marks the result; the whole block often sits inside 是…的. English needs a passive ("was formed by"), but Chinese simply lists the parts first and the result last.
